skill_name: Describe the concept of "habitability" and why architects should consider this
workflow: Habitability refers to the livability of a space, or how comfortable and enjoyable it is to live in. This covers everything from structural integrity and air quality to natural light, size, noise level, and access to fresh air. Architects should consider habitability when they design buildings because it not only affects the quality of life for people living or working there, but also contributes to the overall aesthetic of the space.
